parsed.post: Huge jump! Tested increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.102 to 1.015. The model seems to benefit from increased capacity even within the 5-minute window. Next, I'll try to optimize the learning rate with this deeper architecture.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.1 for the new DEPTH=6 architecture to see if we can further accelerate convergence.
